skill.summary: Scores draft content and recommends practical SEO quality improvements.

content.user_title: Audit SEO Content for Quality and E-E-A-T
content.value_statement: Teams need a fast way to judge whether draft content is complete, credible, readable, and SEO aligned. This skill reviews provided content and returns scores, issues, and actionable recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Reviews content depth, completeness, quality, and originality signals.
Checks visible E-E-A-T signals, citations, author expertise, and trust indicators.
Evaluates heading structure, readability, formatting, and user experience.
Assesses keyword density, distribution, and semantic relevance.
Suggests missing topics, internal linking opportunities, and structure improvements.
Provides a scored audit report with issues and recommendations.
limitations: Does not check live SERP rankings.
Cannot analyze competitor content unless the content is provided.
Does not access search volume data or technical SEO metrics.
Cannot verify real engagement metrics or external credibility claims.

use_cases.title: Review Blog Drafts
use_cases.description: Audit a draft article before publication and identify gaps in depth, trust signals, readability, and keyword use.

use_cases.title: Improve Product Pages
use_cases.description: Find weak copy, missing proof points, unclear structure, and optimization opportunities in product or service pages.

use_cases.title: Prepare Editorial Briefs
use_cases.description: Use the audit results to define missing sections, evidence needs, internal links, and revision priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this article draft for SEO content quality, E-E-A-T signals, readability, keyword use, and missing subtopics. Return scores and prioritized fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Landing Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this landing page copy for search intent fit, structure, trust indicators, keyword coverage, and conversion clarity. Suggest practical revisions.

prompt_templates.title: Find Content Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this content against the target topic and audience. Identify missing sections, weak evidence, internal linking opportunities, and recommended additions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Revision Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this content and create a prioritized revision plan with effort level, expected SEO impact, evidence needs, and quality risks.

output_examples.input: A 1,200 word blog draft about choosing project management software for remote teams.
output: Content depth score: 7 out of 10, with missing sections on onboarding and security.
E-E-A-T score: 5 out of 10, because the draft lacks author credentials and cited sources.
Top recommendation: add comparison criteria, examples, and internal links to related buyer guides.

output_examples.input: A product page for accounting software that targets small business owners.
output: Readability is strong, but trust signals are limited.
Keyword coverage is uneven and should include billing, invoicing, tax preparation, and reporting terms.
Add proof points, customer examples, and a clearer feature hierarchy.

output_examples.input: An existing evergreen guide that has lost organic traffic.
output: The guide needs fresher examples, stronger citations, and clearer section headings.
Several subtopics are underdeveloped, including common mistakes and decision criteria.
Prioritize updates that improve usefulness before adding more keywords.

best_practices: Provide the full content, target audience, primary keyword, and page goal.
Ask for prioritized recommendations when you need a practical editing plan.
Review suggestions against brand voice, legal needs, and subject matter expertise.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to verify live rankings, search volume, or analytics data.
Do not treat keyword density recommendations as exact ranking rules.
Do not use the audit as a replacement for expert review on sensitive topics.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It reviews provided content for SEO quality, E-E-A-T signals, readability, structure, keyword use, and trust indicators.

faq.question: Can it check live search rankings?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that it cannot check actual SERP rankings or search volume data.

faq.question: Does it need the full article?
faq.answer: Full content gives the best audit. Include the target keyword, audience, page goal, and any required constraints.

faq.question: Can it compare competitors?
faq.answer: It can compare provided competitor content. It cannot fetch or analyze competitor pages that are not supplied.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect category scores, specific issues, missing topic suggestions, structure advice, and prioritized improvement recommendations.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
